name: Jiangnan Social University
aliases: Institute of International Relations Suzhou Campus
Ministry of State Security Administrative Institute

evidence.summary: A 1999 Ministry of Education notice lists Jiangnan Social University, an adult higher education institution in Suzhou, with the Ministry of State Security as its supervising department, among the schools whose enrolment it suspended. A 1997 Zhejiang provincial notice on police recruitment names it, with the University of International Relations, as a school belonging to the Ministry of State Security whose graduates enter the state security organs.
